note: BH-7107: how long a HOLD or closed verdict must stand on a live build before the pool destroys the machine and releases the slot. It protects a build that closes its own issue on merge: its RESULT lands inside the window and the reap takes it first. A closed issue parks the row as failed; any other HOLD requeues it with deaths and deferrals unchanged. 0 = cancel on the first held read.
